Who We Are

BUILT BY
ATHLETES.

KLUTCH Sports.Ed is on a mission to transform the way schools deliver Physical Education and Sports. We combine global curriculum, sports science, professional coaching and modern infrastructure to ensure every child gets the right environment to move, learn, compete and grow.

We didn't build KLUTCH from a boardroom. We built it from the field — by athletes who lived the gap between potential and opportunity, and decided to close it.

The Opportunity

GREAT SCHOOLS DESERVE
GREAT SPORTS.

01
No Structured Curriculum
PE periods are scheduled but rarely planned. Without a curriculum, every session starts from zero and ends the same way.
02
Generalist Instruction
PT teachers are committed — but sport-specific coaching is a different skill set. Great coaching requires sport science, not just supervision.
03
No Way to Measure Progress
Without assessments, it's impossible to know which students are developing and which have real potential waiting to be found.
04
No Tournament Culture
Students never experience the thrill of competition. The competitor mindset — pressure, preparation, resilience — is never developed.
The Curriculum

ONE SYSTEM.
FOUR STAGES. BUILT FOR EVERY CHILD.

★ Inspired by SHAPE America — the global standard for Physical Education and Sports curriculum

Pre-Primary
Movement Beginnings
LKG – UKG  ·  Ages 3–6
  • Free movement & body awareness
  • Spatial orientation & motor play
  • Introduction to following instructions through physical activity
"Before sport, comes movement."
Band 1
Physical Foundation
Class 1–4  ·  Ages 6–10
  • Fundamental motor skills & balance
  • Neurological development & coordination
  • Cardiovascular basics
  • Early introduction to sports activities
"The body learns before the game does."
Band 2
Multi-Sport Development
Class 5–7  ·  Ages 10–13
  • Agility, reaction time & team dynamics
  • Recognised competitive sports
  • Introduction to professional sport standards
  • Structured competitive exposure
"This is where confidence is built."
Band 3
Performance & Pathway
Class 8–10  ·  Ages 13–16
  • Advanced athletic conditioning
  • Leadership through sport
  • Deep technical understanding
  • Professional approach to gameplay & strategy
"They don't just play. They perform."

Global Benchmarks

THE WORLD FIGURED THIS OUT.
WE’RE BRINGING IT HERE.

Every nation that dominates sport globally has one thing in common — it starts in school.

🇨🇳
China
Structured sport from primary school

Mandatory programmes, certified coaches and science-backed development from an early age.

🇪🇺
Europe
Consistent Olympic pathways

Age-graduated PE programmes, serious competition and sport embedded in national culture.

🇯🇵
Japan
High youth fitness standards

Sport supports academic discipline and character formation; every session is structured.

🇺🇸
USA
School-to-college pathways

School sport connects to higher education and professional careers through national PE standards.

The Klutch Mission
VISION
INDIA AS A SPORTS HUB.

The Klutch Squad believes that for India to produce world-class athletes across every sport, the grassroots must change first. A competitive mindset cannot be imported — it has to be built, school by school, student by student, through an organised and structured sports curriculum. That's why we start with PE. That's why we start now.
